objective: One persistent task workspace and outcome across memory, perception, rule inference, planning and learned language; native XI learning, no host model or answer generator
task: Recall a binary rule from QMemory, classify 1000 sensor values with VQC3, infer goal 0 or 6 from class XOR rule, plan a step with QRL3, verbalize the actual proposed step with QChat100; refuse if a premise is missing
controls: E01 routing cannot solve a composed mission
selection: Validation only, retain E01 base weights if a continuation regresses; shared-controller and voice updates reported separately; all failures retained
limits: A bounded cooperative task and common evidence/feedback cycle, not open-ended general reasoning, joint differentiation or demonstrated quantum advantage
